svg.title: Diagram 1. System context: Bottle, MOGs and their main agents, the Databricks CLI, workspaces A and B, and optional Lakebase (v1)
svg.desc: The user talks to Bottle on one device. WebView windows (hub, MOG views with the Rive mascot, cards) send view_emit commands to the hidden brain window and get mog.view_state and card.update events back. The brain hosts the bottle-mcp tool server, the agent guardrails, the per-MOG agent action log and the classifier fallback. Each MOG has a main agent harness (Claude Agent SDK or Codex) that routes as its first step and calls bottle-mcp tools and Genie One MCP. Only the Rust core holds tokens and opens sockets. The MVP memory store is one local encrypted SQLite file (SQLCipher, WAL, FTS5, sqlite-vec) with an offline embedding queue. The Databricks CLI runs as a subprocess outside the secret boundary. Workspace A provides Unity Gateway models, the agent model route, Genie One MCP and UC Pages drafts. Workspace B provides Genie One MCP. Lakebase is an optional v1 sync target. The lower panels show the 8-step onboarding wizard and the MVP admin prerequisites.
